title: Public GLIM Livox complete continuous-time refinement

protocol.split_policy: Latest capture frames held out; repeats share the same accuracy fixture
protocol.initial_estimate_policy: Same supplied public config, initial estimate and temporal split
protocol.tuning_policy: Reverse order every other repeat; child OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
protocol.failure_policy: Keep all timings and mismatches; no warmup or excluded outliers

metrics.name: pipeline_seconds
metrics.label: pipeline_seconds
metrics.interpretation: Full evaluation API including replay and provenance hashing

metrics.name: solver_seconds
metrics.label: solver_seconds
metrics.interpretation: Complete clock profile and extrinsic solver call

metrics.name: adaptive_query_seconds
metrics.label: adaptive_query_seconds
metrics.interpretation: Sum of adaptive nearest-plane call durations, including wrapper overhead; durations can overlap for parallel candidates

metrics.name: adaptive_query_calls
metrics.label: adaptive_query_calls
metrics.interpretation: Actual adaptive nearest-plane calls in the complete run

metrics.name: worker_import_seconds
metrics.label: worker_import_seconds
metrics.interpretation: Worker entry through imports, excluding interpreter startup

metrics.name: worker_cpu_seconds
metrics.label: worker_cpu_seconds
metrics.interpretation: All-thread process CPU from worker entry through saved-result hash; excludes interpreter startup and measurement JSON serialization

metrics.name: subprocess_wall_seconds
metrics.label: subprocess_wall_seconds
metrics.interpretation: Fresh complete process wall, including artifact saves

metrics.name: complete_result_matches
metrics.label: complete_result_matches
metrics.interpretation: All artifact values except the exact kernel identity note

limitations: Single public sensor duplicated as an identity control; no absolute two-sensor accuracy claim.
Fresh interpreters; no warmup or outlier exclusion; OS caches persist.
Scope cuda-full substitutes 14 modules. All candidates, refinements, train/holdout budgets and writers are shared. Module filenames and source/input bytes are verified.
Wall includes startup, imports, replay, optimization, diagnostics, input hashes, YAML output and worker measurement save; parent audits and CLI presentation are excluded.
Phase timers wrap existing calls without extra work; their wrapper cost is included.
Full saved/API artifacts and git revision are retained. Comparison normalizes path separators and excludes only the exact optional kernel identity note.
Numba cache policy is recorded per trial, with compiled file hashes before/after. The first candidate uses an empty cache; all import/compile/load work is inside wall.
Compiled scope gives each method its own persistent cache, initially empty.

Candidate execution override: cuda; baseline execution override: cuda; all physical options and splits are shared. CUDA runs also own a fresh persistent kernel cache with trial-level before/after digests; compilation stays inside wall. CUDA dispatch retains CPU execution below the 8192-row capture budget.
Worker CPU sums all worker threads from entry through the saved-result hash; interpreter startup and measurement JSON serialization are outside that diagnostic.
Raw checksums and conversion lineage are verified before measurement.
Split IDs hash ordered sampled target indices, capture timestamps and XYZ; the distinct temporal partitions and unchanged sampling caps are verified each run.
Descriptive timings are local observations, not portable confidence estimates.
